defs.def: a country ruled by a king or queen 王国

ex.s: Shortly before her sixteen birthday, she is shocked by the life-changing news that she is the princess of a fictional kingdom called Genovia.
ex.t: 在她十六岁生日前不久，她被一个改变人生的消息震惊了：她是一个叫做吉诺维亚的虚构王国的公主。

ex.s: For example, the mysterious large-eyed, bronze statues of the ancient Shu Kingdom, discovered at the Chinese archeological site at Sanxingdui, were believed to have been able to look across great distances into the stars.
ex.t: 例如，在中国三星堆考古遗址发现的古代蜀王国神秘的大眼青铜雕像，据信能够跨越遥远的距离仰望星空。

ex.s: Background information Sanxingdui site was the capital of the ancient Shu Kingdom more than 3,000 years ago.
ex.t: 背景信息　三星堆遗址是三千多年前古蜀国的都城。

ex.s: The United Kingdom, Great Britain, Britain, England—many people are confused by what these different names mean.
ex.t: 联合王国、大不列颠、英国、英格兰——许多人被这些不同名字的含义搞糊涂了。

ex.s: Human impact on the animal kingdom, such as hunting and destruction of habitats, ___________a reduction in the population of certain species in the past three decades.
ex.t: 人类对动物王国的影响，如狩猎和栖息地破坏，________导致过去三十年某些物种种群数量的减少。

ex.s: It tells the story of the Greek hero Odysseus and his ten-year voyage home to his island kingdom of Ithaca after the Trojan War, which is the subject of The Iliad.
ex.t: 它讲述了希腊英雄奥德修斯在特洛伊战争后历经十年航行、返回他的岛屿王国伊萨卡的故事，这也是《伊利亚特》的主题。

defs.def: an area controlled by a particular person or where a particular thing or idea is important 管辖范围；领域
one of the three traditional divisions of the natural world 自然三界之一
one of the five major groups into which all living things are organized 界（生物的五大类别之一）
